review: Reviewed the release ui-0d56174a4f42 (source ae3e8549; Core and Smart are the same ui commit, Smart in distr/smart). smart-base.js is byte-identical to the last review; loader.js fetches minified bundles (readable with SF_BOOT_CONFIG.minified = false, ?sf-debug or data-sf-debug) and lets a rule mark a relation lazy, fetched after the page is ready. No attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference the eight lessons teach changes, so none of them changes.
